title: Readable test output in goal reports
acceptance: In the report markdown's test-output block, ANSI escape sequences (CSI sequences such as colors and cursor moves, and OSC sequences) are removed, and carriage-return overwrites are resolved so each line shows its final text

Nothing else is removed, reordered or rewritten in that block: no line is dropped because of what it says (the report pastes the test output, not a verdict, D31); the saved .test.log keeps the raw output byte for byte

hq's own test suite no longer prints report bodies or `Type the goal name to approve` prompts when it calls approve(): approve() writes what it shows through a writer that defaults to stderr and that tests can replace; the CLI still prints the report and the prompt to stderr exactly as before
`cd hq && bun test` output contains no `Type the goal name to approve` line and no `# report` / `# REPORT BODY` line
Tests in hq/test cover: colored and cursor-moving output, OSC sequences, \r progress lines, text that merely looks like a prompt staying in the block, and the raw log staying unchanged
